desc: Heavy Star: the slow, immovable slammer. Units: seconds, metres, hp. Numbers are the same for every player; only baseline follows the weight class.
name: Heavy Star

look.why: ~30% bigger: reads as the heaviest form from across the map

baseline.why: run-speed bonus by weight class (a light hero keeps the most speed; merge cap +40%)

dash.why: a dash is a short ground shock that tugs foes toward you

lmb.name: Gravity Slam
lmb.desc: Slam the ground in a short cone. Knocks foes back. Left and right swings alternate.

rmb.name: Bulldoze
rmb.desc: Hold to roll armoured through foes, carrying them along. Knockback cannot move you. Let go to slam.
rmb.why: 9.5 m/s roll, steering 5.5 rad/s, up to 3.2s; the slam on release grows to full at 1.2s; 50% less damage while rolling

e.name: Gravity Anchor
e.desc: Drag every foe within 5m toward you and slow them.

r.name: Collapse
r.desc: Leap to the marked circle, crash into a crater that pulls foes in, then launches them.
r.why: 0.65s leap with a filling ground marker (7m = the pull's reach), the launch lands 0.4s after the crash
